objective: Add comprehensive unit and integration tests for previously implemented Tasks 1, 2, and 7, covering Venue entity, VenueController.create, POST /venues routes, ApiError, and errorHandler middleware.

decisions.decision: Verify existing backend/tests/Venue.test.js as it already completely tests Task 1 (positional/options constructor, auto id/createdAt generation, belongsTo, and toJSON serialization).

Create backend/tests/ApiError.test.js to test ApiError constructor flexibility, property assignments (statusCode, status, message, name), inheritance from Error, and static factory helpers (badRequest, forbidden, notFound, internal).

Create backend/tests/errorHandler.test.js to test Express error-handling middleware behavior, ensuring it formats { error: message } with appropriate status code from ApiError or defaults to 500 for generic errors.

Modify backend/tests/VenueController.test.js to add a describe block for VenueController.create (Task 2), testing parameter extraction from req.body and req.user, delegation to venueService.registerVenue, toJSON serialization, 201 response, and error handling via next(error) or direct response fallback.

Modify backend/tests/venues.routes.test.js to add an integration test suite for POST /venues and POST /api/venues (Tasks 2 & 7), verifying successful 201 creation with serialized venue response, error translation (400, 403, 500) via errorHandler, and proxy compatibility.

invariants: Do not modify AGENTS.md, .gitignore, or any file under .agents/**.

Preserve all existing tests in backend/tests/Venue.test.js, backend/tests/VenueController.test.js, backend/tests/VenueRepository.test.js, backend/tests/VenueService.test.js, and backend/tests/venues.routes.test.js.
Do not modify any source code files under backend/src/** unless directly necessary for tests to execute.
Tests must follow Jest and Supertest patterns already used across the backend codebase.
All tests must be deterministic, isolated, and leave no side-effects in shared in-memory repositories.

instructions: Verify that Venue.test.js tests constructor parameter handling and id/createdAt generation.
Verify that Venue.test.js tests belongsTo(userId) with matching, non-matching, null, and undefined values.
Verify that Venue.test.js tests toJSON() serialization.
acceptance: Venue.test.js passes without modifications and validates all Task 1 requirements.

instructions: Import ApiError from '../src/errors/ApiError'.
Test constructor with (statusCode, message): verify statusCode, status, message, name = 'ApiError', and instanceof Error.
Test constructor with (message, statusCode): verify statusCode, status, and message are properly set.
Test constructor with defaults: verify statusCode = 500 and message = 'Internal Server Error'.
Test static helper ApiError.badRequest(): returns instance with statusCode 400 and provided or default 'Bad Request' message.
Test static helper ApiError.forbidden(): returns instance with statusCode 403 and provided or default 'Forbidden' message.
Test static helper ApiError.notFound(): returns instance with statusCode 404 and provided or default 'Not Found' message.
Test static helper ApiError.internal(): returns instance with statusCode 500 and provided or default 'Internal Server Error' message.
Test named export: verify require('../src/errors/ApiError').ApiError equals default export.
acceptance: All ApiError unit tests pass when run with Jest.

instructions: Import errorHandler from '../src/middleware/errorHandler' and ApiError from '../src/errors/ApiError'.
Test error handling for ApiError: mocks res.status().json(), passes ApiError(400, 'Bad input'), expects res.status(400) and res.json({ error: 'Bad input' }).
Test error handling for 403 ApiError: passes ApiError.forbidden('Forbidden'), expects res.status(403) and res.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }).
Test error handling for generic Error: passes new Error('Database down'), expects res.status(500) and res.json({ error: 'Database down' }).
Test error handling when error message is empty: defaults to 'Internal Server Error'.
Test named export: verify require('../src/middleware/errorHandler').errorHandler equals default export.
acceptance: All errorHandler unit tests pass when run with Jest.

instructions: Import ApiError from '../src/errors/ApiError'.
Add describe('VenueController.create (Task 2)') block alongside existing describe('VenueController.list (Task 5)').
Test calling create with req.body and req.user: verify venueService.registerVenue is called with req.body and req.user, returns 201, and outputs serialized venue JSON.
Test calling create with venue entity lacking toJSON: returns 201 with raw venue object.
Test error propagation when next is provided: when venueService.registerVenue throws an ApiError or Error, verify next(error) is called.

Test error handling when next is not provided: when venueService.registerVenue throws an ApiError(400, 'Invalid'), verify res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid' }); when generic Error thrown, verify res.status(500).json({ error: message }).
acceptance: All tests in VenueController.test.js (both list and create suites) pass when run with Jest.

instructions: Import venueService from '../src/services/VenueService' and ApiError from '../src/errors/ApiError'.
Add describe('POST /venues Route Integration (Task 2 & 7)') block.
Use jest.spyOn(venueService, 'registerVenue') or mock implementation to isolate service logic for route integration tests.
Test successful venue creation: POST /venues with valid body returns 201 with serialized venue JSON.
Test validation error response: when registerVenue throws ApiError.badRequest('Name is required'), POST /venues returns 400 with { error: 'Name is required' }.
Test unauthorized / forbidden response: when registerVenue throws ApiError.forbidden('Forbidden'), POST /venues returns 403 with { error: 'Forbidden' }.
Test internal server error response: when registerVenue throws generic Error('Internal crash'), POST /venues returns 500 with { error: 'Internal crash' }.
Test proxy route compatibility: POST /api/venues returns 201 with serialized venue JSON.
Restore spies in afterEach / beforeEach.
acceptance: All integration tests in venues.routes.test.js (both GET and POST suites) pass when run with Jest.
